title: Utility relocation slipped 18 days
recommendedAction: Escalate the utility owner delay to Thursday steer. Demand a night-shift recovery plan by 16:00 today.

timeline.label: Utility crew no-show; first 5-day slip logged.
Second window missed; critical path now through drainage.
Recovery calendar still unsigned by utility owner.

title: Contingency draw at 61% with unsigned COs
recommendedAction: Review EAC variance (−$4.2M) and hold further contingency draws until CO-014/019 are commercially closed.

title: CO-014 owner delay unresolved
recommendedAction: Acknowledge commercial blockage and assign a single owner to close CO-014 before the capital-review pack freezes.

timeline.label: Owner legal still reviewing delay language.

title: Night-shift productivity below recovery plan
recommendedAction: Review crew mix with the superintendent; do not assume the 18-day slip heals without a new plan.

timeline.label: Night shift started; output 62% of plan.

title: Recordable trend — 3 in 14 days
recommendedAction: Decide today whether the trend warrants a stop-work conversation with the marine contractor.

timeline.label: First recordable — hand injury on barge deck.
Third recordable — pinched finger during pile set.

title: Crane-barge weather window missed
recommendedAction: Escalate barge rebooking; quantify whether pile-driving can recover inside the season window.

title: Near-miss in pile-driving exclusion zone
recommendedAction: Acknowledge the near-miss in the same conversation as the recordable trend — do not treat it as a separate later topic.

timeline.label: Crew member entered exclusion zone during hammer cycle.

title: Contingency draw needs Cost Lead approval
recommendedAction: Review variance and contingency. Flag for the PM if the cost story is not credible as written.

timeline.label: PM requested contingency draw without Cost Lead flag.

title: Imaging-suite owner change still in pricing
recommendedAction: Review whether this change is already inside the contingency draw story — if yes, say so on the Cost tab.

title: Switchgear long-lead threatens commissioning
recommendedAction: Review a resequence of commissioning vs. accepting an 11-day slip. Cost is not the constraint.

title: Owner-requested cooling upgrade in pricing
recommendedAction: Acknowledge and keep it off the morning escalate list unless pricing lands above allowance.

title: Rail-operator interface package unsigned
recommendedAction: Escalate the third-party signature path before shortened possessions hit next month.

timeline.label: Interface package sent to rail operator.

title: Night possession windows shortened
recommendedAction: Review next-month calendar; do not escalate unless the interface package also slips.

title: Chemical-skid quote 4% over allowance
recommendedAction: Acknowledge. Not a portfolio escalate — watch only.
